conditions: User is on the product list page
A product shows 'Add to cart' button
User clicks 'Add to cart' for one product
items.expected: The clicked button changes to 'Remove'; the cart badge appears and shows '1'

conditions: User has one product in the cart (badge shows '1', button shows 'Remove')
items.expected: The button changes back to 'Add to cart'; the cart badge is no longer shown

conditions: User has two products in the cart (badge shows '2')
items.expected: The removed product's button returns to 'Add to cart'; the cart badge decrements to '1' and remains visible

conditions: User adds a product from the list
User navigates away (e.g. to a product detail page)
User returns to the product list
items.expected: The product's button still shows 'Remove' and the cart badge still shows the correct count after returning to the list

conditions: User is on the product list page after login
axe-core scans the inventory list container with WCAG 2.1 A/AA rules (wcag2a, wcag2aa)
items.expected: No accessibility violations are reported (violations array is empty)

excluded.reason: Add/remove from cart is a functional flow with no security surface — no credentials, no account enumeration, no session boundary changes are involved
